hero.headline: General Tso's until 1am
hero.sub: Bei Jing Chinese Food cooks on East Marshall Street in Norristown. The tickets that leave this kitchen are General Tso's chicken, sesame chicken, sweet and sour chicken, pork fried rice, and beef lo mein. Wonton soup, fried dumplings, and crab rangoons start the bag. Pickup at the counter or delivery from the same stove. Open daily 1pm to 1am.

offerings.heading: What the Marshall Street kitchen sends out

items.title: General Tso's and sesame chicken
items.text: General Tso's chicken and sesame chicken are the plates people reorder. Sweet and sour chicken sits next to them when you want the brighter sauce. Lunch specials put the same dishes on a shorter midday ticket with fried rice.

items.title: Rice, lo mein, and the fried start
items.text: Pork fried rice and beef lo mein fill the box. Wonton soup, fried dumplings, cheese wontons, and crab rangoons are the openers. Wings ride along when the table wants them.

items.title: Lunch specials, then late pickup
items.text: Chow mein, pepper steak, Hunan, and Szechuan shrimp show up on the lunch board. After dark the same kitchen still packs General Tso's and lo mein for pickup or delivery until 1am.

story.heading: A Norristown Chinese kitchen that stays open
paragraphs: East Marshall Street already treats Bei Jing as the late Chinese run. You call 610-275-4086, you name General Tso's or sesame chicken, and the bag comes out hot. Regulars talk about big portions and food that is still steaming when it hits the door.

Pickup walks into 130 E Marshall St. Delivery leaves from the same kitchen, not a ghost brand with a borrowed name. Lunch specials cover the afternoon. The overnight window is the reason Norristown keeps this number saved.

experience.heading: How a Bei Jing order actually moves

items.title: Name the plate
items.text: General Tso's, sesame chicken, sweet and sour, pork fried rice, beef lo mein, wonton soup, dumplings, crab rangoons. The ticket is those dishes, cooked here.

items.title: Grab it or send it
items.text: Walk the counter on East Marshall Street or have the same kitchen deliver. Either path is the Norristown stove, not a third-party commissary.

items.title: Eat it while it is still hot
items.text: Portions come out large. The point of a 1am Chinese run is food that is still hot when you open the bag.

feature.heading: The late-night Chinese number in Norristown
feature.text: General Tso's, sesame chicken, and beef lo mein from a kitchen that stays open until 1am. Lunch specials earlier. Pickup and delivery off East Marshall Street either way.

spotlight.heading: Crab rangoons, then the Tso's
spotlight.text: Start with fried dumplings or crab rangoons. Put General Tso's or sesame chicken in the bag with pork fried rice. Bei Jing has been packing that order for Norristown for a long time.

items.title: General Tso's chicken
items.text: The plate Norristown reorders, packed for pickup or a 1am delivery.

items.title: Sesame chicken
items.text: Next to sweet and sour on the same Marshall Street menu, with lunch specials at midday.

items.title: Pork fried rice and lo mein
items.text: Pork fried rice, beef lo mein, wonton soup, dumplings, and crab rangoons from the same kitchen.
